Night over the old city, cold mist rolling over the rooftops.
Dark archive aisles, the glass jars grey and silent, cold blue mist on the floor.
A tall faceless shadow in a wide hat walks slowly down an archive aisle, glowing jars turning grey where he passes.
The tall shadow in the wide hat in the misty dark, face hidden.
A silver ribbon of light hovers and hides close to the brass lantern.
A gloved shadow hand reaches slowly through the mist.
A small golden music box glows warmly, opening by itself.
A wave of glowing golden musical notes bursts outward, pushing back cold blue frost.
The tall shadow steps back, hat tilting, golden light all around.
The shadow fades into the mist.
Night, a bright star over the rooftops.
